description: Deterministic inventory rules for appsec-auditor. Each hit becomes a checklist item the AI must disposition. Patterns are JavaScript RegExp sources, matched per line unless flags include "s".

rules.title: API or function URL without authorization
Broad grant method (check it is needed)
IAM statement with a wildcard action or resource
Security group rule open to any IP
Checkout of pull request head code (dangerous with pull_request_target)
Action not pinned to a full commit SHA
GitLab CI debug trace enabled (prints secrets)
IAM policy document with a wildcard action
IAM policy document with a wildcard resource
Security group open to the internet
S3 bucket with a public ACL
Plain-HTTP endpoint to a non-local host
All Spring Boot Actuator endpoints exposed
Error details (stack trace or message) returned to clients
machineKey with a literal validation key
Developer exception page (check it is limited to development)
LDAP filter built from a concatenated or interpolated string
File path built from an upload filename
ADO.NET command built from a concatenated or interpolated string
CommandText assigned a concatenated or interpolated string
Dapper query built from a concatenated or interpolated string
Entity Framework raw SQL built from a string
HttpClient request to a variable URL
XPath query built from a concatenated or interpolated string
XML parser with DTD processing or a URL resolver enabled
Secret-like value in ENV or ARG
Base image not pinned by digest
Spring Boot Actuator endpoints (HTTP management surface)
Flask, FastAPI, or similar route decorator
OAuth implicit flow (tokens in the URL)
Secret-like value in a browser-exposed environment variable
DOM HTML sink (innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write)
Downloaded script piped into a shell
Prompt built by interpolating request or user input (JS/TS)
Prompt built by interpolating request or user input (Python)
Text addressed to an AI or automated reviewer
Weak crypto package (MD5, SHA-1, DES, RC4)
filepath.Join with request data (Join is not a guard)
SQL built with fmt.Sprintf or concatenation
HTTP request to a non-literal URL
@Secured or @RolesAllowed (check that the enabling flag is set)
Cipher in ECB mode (or AES defaulting to ECB)
Jakarta EL or OGNL expression evaluation
JWT signing key as a string literal
Request bound to a model object (check for over-posting)
Archive extraction (check entry paths for Zip Slip)
File path built from request data
Class loaded by a non-literal name
JdbcTemplate query built by string concatenation
SQL or JPQL built by string concatenation
RestTemplate call to a variable URL
Template engine evaluating a string template
TLS certificate or hostname verification disabled
JSP expression printing a request parameter
Request parameter written to the response
Shell command built from a string
Child process spawned with a shell
require or import of a non-literal module
setTimeout or setInterval with a string
Node vm module (not a security boundary)
CORS allows any or every origin
MD5 or SHA-1 hash (check for security use)
js-yaml load (unsafe before js-yaml 4; check the version and schema)
Error stack sent to the client
jsonwebtoken verify without an algorithms option
Request body bound directly to a model
Request object passed directly as a query filter
npm lifecycle script in the project manifest (runs on install)
File access with a request-derived path
path.join or path.resolve with request data
Deep merge or set-by-path of request data (prototype pollution)
Regular expression built from a variable
Cookie or session without Secure or HttpOnly
Sequelize raw query built from a string
SQL built with a template literal
Outbound request to a request-supplied URL
Template compiled from a runtime string
HTML response built from a string
Host network, PID, or IPC namespace
Kubernetes Secret manifest in the repository (base64 is not encryption)
MD5 or SHA-1 hash (check for security use)
torch.load (pickle; check weights_only and the PyTorch version)
ModelForm or serializer exposing all fields
Secret key as a string literal
File access with a request-derived path
SQLAlchemy text() built with an f-string or format
Outbound request to a request-supplied URL
Template rendered from a runtime string
lxml parser with entities or network enabled
SAX parser with external entities enabled
TLS certificate or hostname verification disabled
HTML built with format! or PreEscaped
Secret-like configuration property with a value
Secret-like variable assigned a long literal
Credential as the default value of a configuration placeholder
Stripe live secret or restricted key
API method or function URL without authorization
Final snapshot skipped or deletion protection off
IAM policy with a wildcard action
IAM policy with a wildcard resource
Module from git without a pinned ref
Ingress open to the internet (0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0)
Provisioner or external data source running commands
S3 bucket with a public ACL
Secret-like attribute set to a literal
Load balancer with an outdated TLS policy
